title: Unicode 18.0: 175 script font candidate research / NOT verified glyph coverage

verification_levels.family_directory_identified: Matching font family directory was found in Noto Fonts, but glyph cmap coverage was NOT checked.
verification_levels.cjk_font_repository_identified: Published Noto CJK directories found; exact per-codepoint coverage NOT checked.
verification_levels.project_or_generic_candidate_only: Individual Noto development project or generic fallback candidate found; actual compiled binaries and cmap NOT checked.
verification_levels.no_catalog_source_identified: No suitable source identified in inspected catalogs; this does NOT prove there is no existing font.

notes: Font candidate is a research lead, NOT a verified per-codepoint mapping or a promise it can render every code point.
Unicode Script property and Unicode Blocks are different; related_unicode_blocks are informative only.
Script assigned counts exclude Cn, Co, Cs and Cc to match unicode18_all_ranges.json's encoded count; assigned Cf and combining marks may still be invisible or require context.
Color emoji and joining/shaping behavior are outside simple cmap coverage.
Noto source-repo listings are moving-main snapshots and need periodic rechecking.
Do not load all fonts in browsers; use server-side cmap audits and subsets.
